root_cause: The preregistered fifth-occurrence 1-to-4 word-gram rule does not implement the locked V2 repetition construct, which detects four contiguous repeated token blocks of width 1-to-16 or fewer than 35 percent unique four-grams after 32 tokens. It over-truncated legitimate repeated words and stopped too late for four-repeat loops.
decision: Close V489. Authorize one corrected read-only feasibility audit using the exact bound V2 predicate incrementally over its own word-and-punctuation tokenization, applied only to outputs that enter V2 collapse. Noncollapsed outputs and all strong outputs must remain byte-identical; the artifact-derived abstention clause remains unchanged.
